rows.scientific_assessment: The raw PY-cellobiose label occurs for two distinct taxa. Moore 1976 explicitly discusses peptone basal medium for the Eubacterium siraeum occurrence, which is positive occurrence-bound support. It does not establish the Clostridium polysaccharolyticum formulation. Its cited 1975 manual recipe was not recovered. A single resolving identity across both observations remains unsupported; retain this positive partial evidence without generalizing it to the aggregate owner. Withdraw the unsupported peptone component_id and set reference_scope UNMAPPED; retain its existing component_name as historical interpretation, not a newly observed expanded source label. The original assertion method and UNKNOWN/PARTIAL completeness remain unchanged.
rows.precise_remaining_requirement: Resolve the C.polysaccharolyticum PY-cellobiose recipe or separate occurrence ownership; historical PY manual recipe remains unread.

rows.scientific_assessment: The raw PY-fructose observation is Clostridium formicaceticum. Andreesen 1970 publisher abstract confirms the organism and fructose metabolism but does not expose the recipe or digest. Full text is subscription-only in the captured free access. Later current culture media do not establish this historical PY formulation. The inherited peptone expansion remains interpreted and ungrounded. Withdraw the unsupported peptone component_id and set reference_scope UNMAPPED; retain its existing component_name as historical interpretation, not a newly observed expanded source label. The original assertion method and UNKNOWN/PARTIAL completeness remain unchanged.
rows.precise_remaining_requirement: Original PY-fructose preparation/formulation for C.formicaceticum; subscription full text unavailable in this bounded free review.

rows.scientific_assessment: The raw PY-glucose-rumen fluid observation is Treponema socranskii with the source LPSN link naming subsp. paredis. Unrelated Prevotella cultures cannot bind this preparation. Preserve the already withdrawn clarification and all rumen-fluid uncertainty. Withdraw the unsupported peptone component_id and set reference_scope UNMAPPED; retain its existing component_name as historical interpretation, not a newly observed expanded source label. The original assertion method and UNKNOWN/PARTIAL completeness remain unchanged.
rows.precise_remaining_requirement: Original PY base/digest in the stated Treponema preparation, or a primary recipe with a demonstrated source bridge.

rows.scientific_assessment: Moore 1976 confirms the historical Clostridium leptum PY-maltose use; its referenced manual formulation remains unread. The current exact-strain DSM 753 recipe has separate Trypticase peptone (BD BBL) and pepsin-digested meat peptone, 5 g each, and a maltose modification. This comparator demonstrates why neither ingredient may be chosen for the historical single peptone edge without a source bridge. No comparator quantities are imported. Withdraw the unsupported peptone component_id and set reference_scope UNMAPPED; retain its existing component_name as historical interpretation, not a newly observed expanded source label. The original assertion method and UNKNOWN/PARTIAL completeness remain unchanged.
rows.precise_remaining_requirement: Original manual recipe and which peptone constituent the historical single component was intended to represent.

rows.scientific_assessment: The raw PY-pectin observation is Treponema pectinovorum. Smibert 1983 abstract confirms the study but not the historical recipe. The complete current ATCC 1223 sheet names Polypeptone Peptone BD 211910, 5 g, separately from heart-infusion broth. A documented bridge to the historical PY-pectin observation is missing. Neither Bacto Peptone nor Hipolypepton is substituted. Withdraw the unsupported peptone component_id and set reference_scope UNMAPPED; retain its existing component_name as historical interpretation, not a newly observed expanded source label. The original assertion method and UNKNOWN/PARTIAL completeness remain unchanged.
rows.precise_remaining_requirement: Original PY-pectin ingredient list or historical identity linkage to ATCC1223.

Withdraw the unsupported peptone component_id and set reference_scope UNMAPPED; retain its existing component_name as historical interpretation, not a newly observed expanded source label. The original assertion method and UNKNOWN/PARTIAL completeness remain unchanged.
rows.precise_remaining_requirement: C.scindens original PYEG preparation, including whether the abbreviation denotes the inherited three-component interpretation.
